approval.note: Wording matches the PRD §06 content master. Capitalisation follows the approved invitation artwork (A2: 'With Joy and Gratitude, request the pleasure of Your Company for their Wedding'), which the PRD makes the visual authority; the PRD text shows the same words in lower case. Owner to confirm the capitalisation; the build blocks any change to the words themselves.

faqs.question: When should I respond?
faqs.answer: Please respond by the date shown with your invitation. You can return to this website to update your response until that date.

faqs.question: Who is included in my invitation?
faqs.answer: Your invitation is addressed to the members of your household. When you RSVP, the form shows exactly who is included, and you respond for each person by name.

faqs.question: I have an access or dietary need. How do I let you know?
faqs.answer: When you RSVP there is a short, optional notes field. Anything you share there is used only for planning and is passed only to the people who need it to look after you on the day. You are also welcome to contact us directly.

faqs.question: How do I reach you with a question?

approval.note: Contact route not yet supplied. The contact block is rendered from the contact section once set.
Private contact route required before guest launch (PRD §03 exception path, CONTENT-04).

rsvp.comingSoonText: RSVP will open when invitations are sent. Your invitation will include a private link or code for your household.
rsvp.closedText: Online responses have now closed. If you need to change your response, please contact us directly.
rsvp.notesPurpose: Optional. Share anything that helps us look after you, such as dietary or access needs. This is used only for planning and shared only with the people who need it.

approval.note: Backend service, credential delivery and cutoff are undecided. The page shows the coming-soon state to guests; the labeled preview uses synthetic guests only. Synthetic fixtures (PRD §14): PREVIEW = couple with a plus-one slot and a reception-only guest; SOLO = an individual; FAMILY = a named family including children as named invitees.
Retention period and RSVP provider require owner approval before launch. The notice does not claim legal compliance.
